Marta: Need a quick alignment: upcoming release — marketing wants docs + changelog + benchmark blurb for Tuesday 10:00 PT publish. Can eng confirm merge timing?
Ravi: We can merge changelog by 08:45 PT if reviews finish by 08:15.
Sam: PR is open now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/544 — includes migration note and short breaking line.
Olivia: Ops prefers a single canary at 11:30 PT (10% traffic). No warm canary earlier.
Marta: Marketing intends to post at 10:00 and send email at 10:10. Will that conflict?
Ravi: No block. We'll have a rollback route and health checks so post can go regardless.
Marta: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "observed up to ~2x median latency reduction at 1k QPS in our harness; ~15% typical cost savings" 1eng ok?
Sam: Fine, add a footnote in docs linking to test harness. I'll update PR.
deploy-bot: Release window booked: canary-2026-12-01-11:30 (10% traffic). Monitor: latency_p50, error_rate. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/canary-2026-12-01-11:30
Marta: Great — Priors: send CDN path for benchmark image when uploaded and UTM campaign name. Will finalize copy after PR merge. Thanks!
